message: Stream 'testpack.avg_balance_interest', lowered from contract 'test.avg_balance_contract', reads a field's previous period but runs from the model's first period, where there is none. Start the contract's term one period after the model, or have the rule carry the opening value as a field of its own.
hint: A field's previous period is the close before this one; the first period has no close before it.
